answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer locks 200 credits in escrow and needs a sponsor, so every referral link is public. A careful sponsor guards a pearl of reputation built over many epochs. Any peer may dispute a link, and that signal triggers an evidence check; a proven fake forfeits its deposit, half to the reporter. Fake links collapse like karst ground once one is probed. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000x200=200,000 credits, while one honest agent pays 200 once and earns it back, so its reward is not diluted.
